slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the mutual exclusion, if a 4-month contract is chosen, does that mean the 4-month contract must cover the full required area for all 4 months, or can it cover only part of the area while other contracts cover the rest?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about full-area coverage for a 4-month contract, which is related to contract coverage, but did not explicitly ask whether a signed contract must remain active for every month in its term or whether partial usage across months is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the plan must include at least two distinct contract lengths or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a maximum limit on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For each month, must the total area rented exactly equal the required area, or is it acceptable to rent more area than required (with the excess going unused)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly match required area or whether excess is allowed, fully covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months, with no other costs or constraints to consider?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost over the 4 months.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be signed, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no cap on the number of distinct contract lengths that can be used.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary includes no such limit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H2 (contract length diversity) remained unresolved; it never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths are required.

summary: The agent resolved the P0 slots on exact demand satisfaction and cost minimization, but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and the P2 maximum-distinct-contracts limit, then stopped with H2 unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
